nonelective_contribution.formula_readable: The Company may, in its sole discretion, make Qualified Non-Elective Contributions to PESP. No specific percentage or formula is stated. These contributions are 100% vested and nonforfeitable when allocated, and must generally be made to the Plan by the end of the 12-month period following the applicable Plan Year.

employer_match.formula_readable: For Prudential employees, the Company matches 100% of Before-Tax and Roth 401(k) contributions (excluding Catch-Up Contributions) up to a combined maximum of 4% of Eligible Earnings each payroll period, resulting in a maximum Company match of 4% of Eligible Earnings. For Assurance IQ employees (effective January 1, 2024), the Company matches 50% of Before-Tax and Roth 401(k) contributions up to a combined maximum of 4% of Eligible Earnings, resulting in a maximum Company match of 2% of Eligible Earnings. A true-up contribution is made in the first quarter of each Plan Year to ensure participants receive the full Company Matching Contribution to which they are entitled based on their prior year's contributions.

eligibility.entry_dates: First day of Employment with the Company
eligibility.formula_readable: Generally, all full-time and part-time Employees are eligible to participate in PESP. Employees may enroll at any time starting on their first day of Employment with Prudential or Assurance IQ. If an eligible Employee does not affirmatively elect to participate or decline within 30 days of hire (applicable to those hired on or after January 1, 2001 at Prudential, or on or after August 1, 2023 at Assurance IQ), they will be automatically enrolled at a 4% contribution rate.

employee_contributions.formula_readable: Employees are always fully vested in their Before-Tax Contributions, Roth 401(k) Contributions, Catch-Up Contributions, After-Tax Contributions, Rollover Contributions, Qualified Matching Contributions, Qualified Non-Elective Contributions, and any related investment results.

immediate_vest_triggers: Reaching age 65 while employed by the Company or any of its Affiliates
Becoming totally disabled (eligible to receive long term disability benefits under The Prudential Welfare Benefits Plan)
Death while employed by the Company or any of its Affiliates
Having been 100% vested during a prior period of service with the Company or any of its Affiliates
Current or former employees of Assurance IQ are fully vested in Company Matching Contributions in their Assurance Match Account regardless of years of service
employer_match.formula_readable: Participants become 100% vested in Company Matching Contributions and Discretionary Company Contributions upon completing three years of Vesting Service. Vesting is also accelerated to 100% upon reaching age 65 while employed, becoming totally disabled (as defined by eligibility for long term disability benefits), dying while employed, or having been 100% vested in a prior period of service. If a participant leaves before full vesting, non-vested amounts are forfeited when the Period of Separation equals five years. Current and former employees of Assurance IQ are 100% vested in their Assurance Match Account regardless of years of service.

nonelective.formula_readable: Discretionary Company Contributions follow the same vesting schedule as Company Matching Contributions: participants become 100% vested upon completing three years of Vesting Service, reaching age 65 while employed, becoming totally disabled, dying while employed, or having been 100% vested during a prior period of service. Qualified Non-Elective Contributions are immediately 100% vested.

nonelective_contribution.formula_readable: The Company may, in its sole discretion, make Qualified Non-Elective Contributions to PESP on a participant's behalf. If made, they are credited to the participant's Qualified Non-Elective Contributions Account and are always fully vested. No specific percentage of pay or fixed formula is stated; the amount and eligibility are determined at the Company's sole discretion, and participants will be notified if such a contribution is made.

employer_match.formula_readable: For Prudential employees, the Company matches 100% of Before-Tax and Roth 401(k) contributions (excluding Catch-Up Contributions) up to a combined maximum of 4% of Eligible Earnings each payroll period, resulting in a maximum Company match of 4% of Eligible Earnings. For Assurance IQ employees (effective January 1, 2024), the Company matches 50% of Before-Tax and Roth 401(k) contributions up to a combined maximum of 4% of Eligible Earnings, resulting in a maximum Company match of 2% of Eligible Earnings. A year-end true-up is performed in the first quarter of each Plan Year to ensure eligible employees receive the full Company Matching Contribution for the prior year; employees must be actively employed on December 31 of the Plan Year to qualify for the true-up.
